food-spicy-clams.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Qingdao la chao gala spicy stir-fried Manila clams: a shallow round plate piled with many opened small oval ridged clam shells, plump cooked clam meat inside, shiny light reddish-brown stir-fry sauce, red dried chili pieces, fresh green scallion and sliced garlic. The dish must read as Chinese chili-garlic stir-fried clams, not mussels, razor clams, Thai basil curry or creamy seafood soup.
